title: RWE Bridge Canonical Event Envelope
description: V32.4.1 stable wrapper for Project 2088 canonical events. Event-specific payload contracts remain owned by the Canonical Event Registry.

event_id.description: Client-generated immutable event occurrence ID. Reused for idempotent retries of the same event.

event_name.description: Exact registered canonical event name in lowercase domain.action notation.

event_version.description: Version of the registered event contract.

schema_version.description: Canonical Event Registry/schema version used to validate this message.

timestamp.description: UTC occurrence time, ISO-8601 with Z suffix.

project_id.description: Canonical project/product identity. Project 2088 currently uses RWE-P2088.

build_id.description: Canonical registered build identity, e.g. RWE-P2088-BUILD-098.

installation_id.description: Identity of the installed game instance. One installation may produce many sessions.

session_id.description: Canonical session identity. Required on canonical gameplay/QA events.

source_system.description: Registered producer/source system. It must be authorised to emit the event domain.

tester_id.description: Longitudinal QA tester identity. Nullable for approved anonymous/local test modes.

player_instance_id.description: Per-session player actor identity. Distinct from tester/account identity.

payload.description: Event-specific fields defined by the Canonical Event Registry. This envelope does not invent payload synonyms.
